title: Fixed Offset Arched-Arm Parasol
description: One newly authored complete static cantilever parasol. A broad side ballast carries one continuous curved rectangular mast that rises outside the shade footprint and arches above its crown. A short fixed suspension stem, upper rib crown and lower stretcher hub hang a full thick rectangular-plan domed canopy with eight complete curved ribs and eight fixed diagonal stretchers. There is no ground-reaching central pole below the canopy. This is a whole side-supported structure, not the old central-pole umbrella moved sideways, resized, recoloured or repeated; no old umbrella geometry is imported. The canopy is one closed finite-thickness shell with integral muted panel materials and a lightly scalloped edge, not independent overlapping sheets. Twenty-two closed editable parts, four opaque solid PBR materials, metres, Z up and horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin. One complete prop, zero scenes. One fixed open visual only: no folding, crank, latch or hinge motion, fabric physics, ballast sufficiency, stability, wind/rain/UV protection, person clearance, installation, manufacture, loading or public-space safety claim.
